verdict.rationale: Vue's documentation includes an API section, an Examples section and a Tutorial (vue-docs-16, vue-docs-12, vue-docs-11), and claims 'world-class documentation' (vue-docs-3). However, nothing in the evidence shows that the API reference is interactive or that the examples can be run in-browser. missing for 10: evidence that the API reference is interactive, evidence of runnable/editable examples (e.g. an embedded playground), and independent hands-on corroboration.
